name: OpenCode
subtitle: Uses OpenCode's local API when Auto-Send is on (queues directly into the active session). Pastes into the composer when Auto-Send is off.

name: Antigravity IDE
subtitle: Activates Antigravity IDE and pastes the annotated screenshot and text into the active composer.

name: Claude
subtitle: Activates Claude Desktop and pastes the annotated screenshot and text into the active composer.

name: Cursor
subtitle: Activates Cursor and pastes the annotated screenshot and text into the active chat.

name: VS Code
subtitle: Activates VS Code and pastes the annotated screenshot and text into the active chat.

name: Active Window
subtitle: Pastes into whichever app is currently focused on your Mac.

name: Custom App
subtitle: Activates a custom macOS app by name or bundle ID and pastes into its active composer.
